edits.current: The universal Colombian rule - payment o credit in account. Applies to the electronic payroll (DIAN Resolution 000013 of 2021 art. 3), to Form 350, to Form 220 and to Format 2276.
edits.proposed: The universal Colombian rule - payment or credit in account. Applies to the electronic payroll (DIAN Resolution 000227 of 2025 art. 1.5.3.2.2), to Form 350, to Form 220 and to Format 2276.

edits.current: Monthly - ONE document per employee per month, irrespective of the pay cycle (Res. DIAN 000013 de 2021 art. 3)
edits.proposed: Monthly - ONE document per employee per month, irrespective of the pay cycle (Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 art. 1.5.3.2.2)

edits.current: FIRST TEN DAYS of the month following the payment or credit in account (Res. DIAN 000013 de 2021 art. 8)
edits.proposed: FIRST TEN DAYS of the month following the payment or credit in account (Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 art. 1.5.3.4.1.1)

edits.current: Fees of a non-executive director (honorarios de junta directiva) are not derived from an employment relationship, so they are outside the document, which supports only payments derived from an employment or statutory relationship and pensions borne by the employer (Res. DIAN 000013 de 2021 art. 2). They are paid and withheld outside payroll and reported by the payer in the third-party information return, as for an independent contractor (see the contractor row). A director who also holds an employment contract is reported for that contract only (see the executive-director row).
edits.proposed: Fees of a non-executive director (honorarios de junta directiva) are not derived from an employment relationship, so they are outside the document, which supports only payments derived from an employment or statutory relationship and pensions borne by the employer (Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 art. 1.5.3.2.1). They are paid and withheld outside payroll and reported by the payer in the third-party information return, as for an independent contractor (see the contractor row). A director who also holds an employment contract is reported for that contract only (see the executive-director row).

edits.current: Res. 000013 de 2021 art. 26 makes the peso mandatory. A foreign currency may be ADDED to a graphical representation but never substituted; the TRM element (NIE200) exists in the schema but is out of scope for a Colombian payroll.
edits.proposed: Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 art. 1.5.3.8.5 makes the peso mandatory. A foreign currency may be ADDED to a graphical representation but never substituted; the TRM element (NIE200) exists in the schema but is out of scope for a Colombian payroll.

edits.current: The document is the support of the payments or credits in account made to the employee in the month (Res. DIAN 000013 de 2021 arts. 2-3); it is not a periodic return. Where no payment or credit in account is made to an employee in the month (for example a full-month unpaid leave or suspension), no document is generated for that employee, and there is no nil document at employer level. Where payments exist but the deductions absorb them, a document IS generated with ComprobanteTotal 0.00 (see the zero-net-pay row).
edits.proposed: The document is the support of the payments or credits in account made to the employee in the month (Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 arts. 1.5.3.2.1 and 1.5.3.2.2); it is not a periodic return. Where no payment or credit in account is made to an employee in the month (for example a full-month unpaid leave or suspension), no document is generated for that employee, and there is no nil document at employer level. Where payments exist but the deductions absorb them, a document IS generated with ComprobanteTotal 0.00 (see the zero-net-pay row).

edits.current: The DIAN document-search URL with the CUNE as the key. Technical Annex s.13.1 fixes the payload. If a graphical representation (payslip PDF) is issued, this QR must be printed at not less than 2 cm x 2 cm on EVERY page (Resolution 000013 of 2021 art. 24 and Annex s.13.1).
edits.proposed: The DIAN document-search URL with the CUNE as the key. Technical Annex s.13.1 fixes the payload. If a graphical representation (payslip PDF) is issued, this QR must be printed at not less than 2 cm x 2 cm on EVERY page (DIAN Resolution 000227 of 2025 art. 1.5.3.8.3 and Annex s.13.1).

edits.current:
Technical Annex table 5.5.1: 1 Semanal, 2 Decenal, 3 Catorcenal, 4 Fortnightly, 5 Monthly, 6 Otro. IMPORTANT: this describes how the EMPLOYEE IS PAID; it does NOT change the document frequency. Resolution 000013 of 2021 art. 3 requires ONE monthly document per employee whatever the pay cycle, so a fortnightly payroll reports PeriodoNomina = 4 on a single monthly document.

Source: the employee's pay group (HR master field 'Pay Group'), mapped to the table 5.5.1 code - for example 'CO - Monthly' -> 5. The code is set per employee from the pay group, not as a company constant. The pay-group-to-code mapping table, covering every pay cycle in use (monthly, weekly advance and any other cycle), is maintained as a configuration table.

edits.current: ISO 4217 currency of the amounts. For a Colombian payroll this is COP. Res. 000013 de 2021 art. 26 makes the Colombian peso mandatory; another currency may be ADDED to a graphical representation but never substituted. Bidirectional pair with 'Exchange rate' (NIE200): NIE200 is present only where this field is a non-COP ISO code, and must be absent where it is COP.
edits.proposed: ISO 4217 currency of the amounts. For a Colombian payroll this is COP. Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 art. 1.5.3.8.5 makes the Colombian peso mandatory; another currency may be ADDED to a graphical representation but never substituted. Bidirectional pair with 'Exchange rate' (NIE200): NIE200 is present only where this field is a non-COP ISO code, and must be absent where it is COP.

edits.current: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code. For Colombia this is 'es'. Res. 000013 de 2021 art. 26 makes Spanish mandatory on the graphical representation; another language may be added, never substituted.
edits.proposed: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code. For Colombia this is 'es'. Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 art. 1.5.3.8.5 makes Spanish mandatory on the graphical representation; another language may be added, never substituted.

edits.proposed: Corporate name of the technology provider that generated and transmits the document. Where Mercans generates on the employer's behalf, Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 art. 1.5.3.8.1 additionally requires the provider to be enabled by DIAN, registered in the RUT, and both parties to retain the mandate document.

edits.current: Registered corporate name exactly as held in the RUT. Item 1 of the thirteen mandatory content items of Res. 000013 de 2021 art. 5.
edits.proposed: Registered corporate name exactly as held in the RUT. Item 2 of the thirteen mandatory content items of Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 art. 1.5.3.3.1.

edits.current:
The basic salary actually earned for the days worked. Moves with DiasTrabajados; contrast Sueldo (NIE062), which is the static contractual figure. This is the single largest input to the ET art. 388 depurated withholding base and to the PILA contribution base.

Source: wage types 62100 'Ordinary Salary- 0003' and 62140 'Integral Salary- 0423'. Vacation days are not in this element (paid through WT 79401 -> NIE112). WT 62149 (intern support) does not belong here (-> NIE157). The salary arrears WTs 62101 'Arrears - Ordinary salary', 62141 'Arrears-Integral Salary' and 65820 are basic salary of an earlier period paid in this period: under the payment-date rule (Res. DIAN 000013 de 2021 art. 3) they are reported in the month of payment, in the element of the concept they settle, so an arrears of basic salary is reported in this element; the element attribute of each arrears wage type comes from the WTC.
